description: The Lexpad Player's window (the web app's /player route): the media engine (files only by the ids the core gave for what the learner dropped or chose; the stream over the lexmedia scheme), words saved from it (to the notebook, or kept until sign-in), the add-a-word card's calls (the account's notebooks, a meaning, an add, the report form), connecting in the browser, every API call through the core as Lexpad's window has, opening Lexpad's window at an app path, and its own window: moving it by its top edge, minimising, maximising, closing, full screen, the mini player kept on top, the Mac's window buttons, its right-click menu (the system's menu, drawn by the core from the items the page names) and Copy Line (plain text onto the clipboard). Nothing else: no file system, no shell, no other window.
